notes:
Inbound SMB lead via self-serve. Main pain: perceived latency on short chat replies; customers noticing slow answers for quick ticket triage. Key excerpts:
- CTO Maya Li: "Users notice lag on quick replies, especially for EU customers — hurts SLAs for our live agent assist."
- Observed metrics (customer supplied): p50 ~120ms (ok), p95 ~800-1200ms when model: rwd-1-large via eu-west. Spike correlates with payload size + sporadic retries.
Initial troubleshooting done by SE:
- Reproduced via curl from eu-west test VM; p95 900-1.1s on non-stream calls.
- Confirmed default client timeout = 15s in their SDK; some calls aborted and retried which increased apparent latency.
Perf tuning advice given in call + follow-up email (high-level):
- Region: recommend routing EU traffic to eu-central or us-west for their customer distribution; test both — latency varies with infra at peak.
- Timeouts: increase client timeout to 30s for long responses; set server-side max_new_tokens to 256 to bound generation time.
- Prompt engineering: enforce prompt truncation for user message history >1500 tokens; provide guidance to condense system prompts and prefer retrieval-augmented summaries.
- Streaming: enable streaming responses for UI to render first tokens immediately (perceived latency improvement).
- Model variants: suggest rwd-1-medium or quantized rwd-1-small for lower median latency; provide quality regression checklist.
- Caching: enable prefix/KV caching for repeated system prompts (they have many templated replies).
- Retries/backoff: recommended exponential backoff + jitter and avoid aggressive client retries on 5xx to prevent amplification.
POC ask: run 48-hr perf run with 2 regions (eu-central, us-west-2), two model variants (rwd-1-medium, rwd-1-small-quantized) and streaming enabled. Need to capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/second, error rates.
Quote from Maya on next step: "If we can get reliable ~200-300ms p95 for quick replies, we'll move forward with paid credits + 1 year commit."
Open items / blockers:
- SSO (SAML) sign-off requires security checklist (they asked for SOC2 attestation + audit log example) — we linked security FAQ but legal review pending.
- They want default timeout settings spelled out in docs (client + server recommendations) — added to docs backlog.
- Customer requested sample curl reproducible script and perf-run template (sent drive links).
CRM notes style: fragments, action items, handoffs. Follow-up scheduled: SE to run perf trial 2025-03-15 to 2025-03-17, then review on 2025-03-18.
